meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: Claude 能帮你管理“代理容器可访问的目录”清单：显示当前允许的目录，添加或移除条目，并设置每条为只读或可读写；结果写入配置文件。新设置只对之后启动的容器生效。
howto.when: 当你说出“mounts”“mount allowlist”“container mounts”等词，或要求查看/添加/移除代理容器能访问的目录时。

say.text: 显示当前允许访问的目录
say.note: Claude 会列出白名单条目及读写权限。
路径存在则写入白名单并设为只读。
新容器不再挂载该目录。

howto.what_en: Claude can manage which host directories agent containers may access: it shows the current allowlist, adds or removes entries, and sets each as read-only or read-write, writing the config file. New settings apply to containers spawned afterward; existing running containers need a group restart.
howto.when_en: When you say 'mounts', 'mount allowlist', 'container mounts', etc., or ask to view, add or remove directories agents can access.

say_en.text: Show me the currently allowed directories.
say_en.note: Claude lists the allowlist entries with read/write flags.
If the path exists, Claude saves it as read-only.
New containers will no longer mount that path.
